#   expect      tone = a tone must be there; null = it must cancel; noise = no tone at all
#   level_ref   ref = this reading SETS the lane's balanced reference
#               single = about -6.02 dB under that reference (one leg of a balanced pair)
#               null   = at or below -30 dB relative to the same jack's single-ended reading
#               ein    = the input noise window
#               info   = measured and reported
#   polarity    ref = sets the lane's reference phase; normal/inverted = against it;
#               info = reported only; - = not applicable
#   park        which end of the lead is PARKED on a socket already proved
#               which end the runner binds at run time: find = the first patch of
#               all
